samples.question: The badge starts in the state shown. Read the eight numbered cards from left to right. A FLIP card changes ON to OFF or OFF to ON. At a GUARD card, if the badge is ON, do not execute the next card and continue with the following card; if the badge is OFF, continue normally. Skipped cards have no effect. What state remains after the program? Answer ON or OFF.
